title: Workspace link
responsibility: Opens an address within the selected project while preserving normal browser behavior for modified clicks.

inputs.name: WorkspaceLink.workspace
inputs.description: The selected project and the navigation action used when the link is opened here.

inputs.name: WorkspaceLink.to
inputs.description: The destination address within the app. The hosting app adds its own address prefix.

inputs.name: WorkspaceLink.class
inputs.description: Optional appearance classes for the link.

inputs.name: WorkspaceLink.label
inputs.description: Optional screen-reader name when the visible content does not explain the action.

inputs.name: WorkspaceLink.title
inputs.description: Optional short tooltip shown when the pointer rests over the link.

inputs.name: WorkspaceLink.children
inputs.description: The visible text or icon inside the link.

outputs.name: WorkspaceLink
outputs.description: A navigation link. Ordinary clicks open here; modified clicks keep the browser’s usual behavior.
